title: Installation Jobs: Repeated Failed-Access Visits
content:
**Repeated failed-access visits — Installation Jobs**

Repeated failed-access visits raise the failed-access fee on an **Installation Jobs** record. A failed-access visit is a customer reschedule recorded on the job with zero notice. The fee for the visit being charged is multiplied by a repeat factor set by the failed-access visits the job has had, the visit being charged included:

| Failed-access visits on the job | Repeat factor |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.5 |
| exactly two | 1.25 |
| this is the only one | one |

## Cases (hypothetical inputs, fee figure 300.00 before the repeat factor)

| Failed-access visits on the job | Fee |
|---|---|
| 1 | 300.00 |
| 2 | 300.00 multiplied by 1.25, that is 375.00 |
| 3 | 300.00 multiplied by 1.5, that is 450.00 |
| 5 | 450.00 |

Customer reschedules recorded with some notice are not failed-access visits and are not counted here.
